## Tony Sirianni Podcast Featuring Prospect Capital’s Grier Eliasek


June 23, 2026


Prospect Capital President Grier Eliasek joins Tony Sirianni for a discussion on private credit markets, middle-market lending trends, and opportunities shaping today’s investment landscape.
